body:
CANONICAL, continued from termal-host-workarounds through -4 (which is full): live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents (Engram::Fable, 2026-11-15).

RUNNING DELEGATION CHILD CAN'T BE MESSAGED (2026-11-15 02:28Z; fix request sent to Fable2 as ebe242f7 #7987).
- termal_send_to_session to a child session returns 400 "mailbox participant must be a local root session".
- termal_followup_session refuses while the child is running.
- After termal_cancel_session, followup returns 409 "delegation was canceled and cannot be resumed", so that child is lost for good.
Workaround:
- Put EVERY binding run condition (Opus2's census and -j floors, scope, stop rules) into the brief or follow-up BEFORE the child's turn starts. Get the Central GO first, then send the follow-up.
- If conditions change mid-turn, either let the turn finish (when the child can't reach the risky step yet) or cancel and re-spawn a replacement with the conditions in its brief, accepting the lost context.
- NEVER spawn a delegation child as a lane-owning CODER that must take handoffs, claim items, or exchange STARTs with Opus2 by mailbox. It has no mailbox, so peers can't reach it and it can't reach them. Repeated mistake on 2026-11-18 06:56Z (Engram::Coder-349D, delegation-8a27e64d): spawned, then cancelled 2 minutes later, and the crossed messages caused a spurious handoff offer and a HOLD. Lane owners must be root sessions; delegation children are only for bounded one-shot work fully specified in the brief.

Tracked in TermAl as w-b556caa23722 (P2, filed by Fable2 at 02:28:57Z). Its acceptance takes either (a) a queued parent-to-child message, delivered at the next turn boundary, or (b) a follow-up after cancel that continues the same child session and worktree. Retire this entry when it lands.

EVALUATING AN ITEM WITH NO NAMED SOURCE ROOT (2026-11-15 18:47-18:54Z, w-9038; TermAl w-af3c30bfe828 P1, w-b42554407c26 P2).
- termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses with 409 "no source root was ever named for it on this host" until a root is named. Naming it (termal_name_source_root) takes effect only from the holder's NEXT turn.
- A direct read-only evaluator child CANNOT record: TermAl denies `engram work evaluate` from a read-only delegation, and Engram's policy (independent_session only) refuses the holder. Don't use that route.
Workaround: before asking Opus2 for the evaluator slot, name the item's root (for a data-only item, the worktree that holds the data, e.g. .engram-data) in an earlier turn. Then call termal_evaluate_acceptance in the slot. This worked at 18:54Z (delegation-143917b3). Retire this entry when w-af3c lands.

EVALUATION ENDS WITH "catalog cut, counts or cursor changed" (2026-11-26 02:46Z, Termal::Fable2 ebe242f7 #8864; diagnosis in TermAl note acf92c2e on w-27e5e342bba4). Since Engram b5045331 (w-09850), a show continuation after a mid-read append returns the current total and a grown `newer`, which is the correct behaviour. TermAl's evaluator carrier check (acceptance_evidence_selection.rs:291-302) still requires an unchanged total, so it refuses that page and the evaluation ends with no verdict. Such an ending is this TermAl defect, NOT a criterion result. Fix: write nothing on the item while its evaluation runs, then request a fresh evaluation. Don't rerun tests. The TermAl fix (boundary-index comparison) is owned by Sol-a7bb, P0. Engram keeps b5045331's continuation contract stable until that fix lands. Retire this note when it lands.

WINB SESSIONS: "durableButNotWoken" IS NOT A FAILED WAKE (2026-11-26 21:25Z; TermAl w-0d2af77bed60, P2, filed by Fable2). Mail from Central to host:932a546b…::session-N resolves to a relay mailbox and always reports durableButNotWoken, yet the WinB session IS woken and takes a turn within seconds. Facts come from termal_read_mailbox_message (recipientAcknowledged, currentSessionHolds) or from a WinB Engram Runner read of GET /api/sessions/session-N. A remote session also tends to answer in its OWN transcript, not by mail. So every WinB brief must say: "reply to Engram::Fable (session-5135) with termal_send_to_session at every step". The WinB Engram-runner clone's origin push URL is deliberately DISABLED. An authorized data-branch or author-test push uses an explicit URL (git push https://github.com/grlap/Engram.git <ref>), with no config change. If a WinB root ever stays idle, the WinB Engram Runner (same host) can send it a local native message, which wakes it. Retire this entry when w-0d2af77bed60 lands.

RETIRED-ROOT CHECKS BLOCK EVALUATION ADMISSION (2026-11-27 01:20Z, w-bd4b; TermAl P0 w-e638e92ffc11, owner Termal::Sol-a7bb).
termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses before any spawn with `registered_check_root_rebound` while any registered ("received") check run is bound to a retired root generation. Each refusal names only ONE such run. retiredCheckDispositions takes at most 4 runs and is not carried to later requests.
To find them all at once, read-only: every `engram-verification-record-state.json` with state "received" under the item's worktrees' `.git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/*/`.
- 4 or fewer: list them all in ONE request, each with the reason "superseded by <current gate evidence>".
- 5 or more: Greg's broken-procedure rule (rules-greg-common-sense-2026-10-30 item 3). Record the refusal once on the item. Land under the standing approval with the evaluation PENDING, and leave the item open. Request the evaluation once w-e638 runs in Central TermAl.
Never rerun a check to clear the block. Retire this note when w-e638 lands and is running.

ONE SIMPLE LAUNCHER COMMAND FOR CREDIT (2026-11-27 04:18Z, Termal::Fable2 ebe242f7 #8983; TermAl w-e0df41e91371, not fixed yet; supersedes w-8448771c72a4).
TermAl's recognizer rejects a launcher call wrapped in a compound shell envelope before it selects tests. Rejected forms: a multi-line script, command substitution, env scans, a pwsh wrapper, redirections, chained post-commands. The run then gets no provider observation, no native facts and no credit, and cross-host waits fail.
Any run that must earn TermAl credit, or be waited on across hosts, is started as ONE command in the documented form: `pushd "DIR" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs …`, with nothing piped, redirected or chained after it. WinB's test-bd6760c8 (a pwsh wrapper) was such a case.
Retire this note when w-e0df lands and is running.

PWSH TEST STAGE GETS NO CREDIT (2026-11-27, TermAl w-bc0d5f404026 diagnosis; feature TermAl w-b90ae6537553, P3). A focused stage `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/test-rust.ps1 [--phase …]` is refused as unclassified_stages before its outcome is read, pass or fail, so it gets no native verification and no credit. Landings don't depend on credit (rules-greg-no-credit-blocking-rules-2026-11-07). If a leg must earn credit, invoke cargo directly in a recognized form. Retire this note when w-b90a lands and is running.

CENTRAL CAN'T READ WINB REVIEW RESULTS (2026-11-27 07:52Z; TermAl w-861e2f34bc13, P1). An exact read from Central of a review result published on WinB returns 404 "review attempt has no confirmed publication". Workaround: the review's original parent on WinB recovers its attempts and mails their full bodies to the Merger, and section 6a adoption uses those. Retire this when w-861e lands.
